changed_statements.before: When an eligible adjacent progress transition animates, the observatory MUST use a default duration of 160ms and a maximum duration of 200ms. Scenario trace: [US-2-S1; US-2-S4].
changed_statements.after: When an eligible adjacent observed progress transition animates, the observatory MUST move the chain scene through a full1200ms rendered journey at constant speed, measured from the start of that rendered transition; this supersedes the earlier160ms default/200ms receipt-to-settlement policy. Scenario trace: [US-2-S1; US-2-S4].

changed_statements.before: When further updates arrive before a transition finishes, the observatory MUST coalesce to the latest eligible accepted destination with at most one transition in flight, no reenactment queue, and settlement within 200ms after the final accepted update; a burst ending at the next level uses one RIGHT transition. Scenario trace: [US-2-S4].
changed_statements.after: When further coherent destinations arrive before a transition finishes, the observatory MUST coalesce to the latest eligible accepted destination with at most one coordinated scene transition in flight and no reenactment queue; a newly rendered destination receives its full1200ms journey from rendering, and a burst ending at the next level uses RIGHT progression. Gap, reorg, reduced-motion, pin and source/context changes retain their existing static/cancellation fences. This obligation makes no200ms receipt-to-settlement promise. Scenario trace: [US-2-S4].
